messages:
jia: Quick note: support reported odd negative cache-savings on the cost hover for a low-traffic route after we enabled 0.005 sampling. Example: route=/compose model=redwood-3b -> -$0.05.
maria: that's the warmup amortization math biting us. tiny n -> estimate noise.
rajiv: agree. backend currently returns a single estimate. we should return sample_count + a CI band and a source flag (live|rollup|suppressed).
ben: implement plan: if sample_count >= 100 return live analytic + ci; if 30 <= sample_count < 100 return rollup (24h) with note; if <30 suppress and show "insufficient samples" CTA. thresholds configurable per org.
maria: console UX: show "n=XX, 95% CI: [$L, $H]" under the number and a small "why noisy" link. show clock icon when using rollup.
rajiv: add query flag force_live_estimate (feature-flagged, audited) for debuggers. backend to include header X-Rollup-Used.
ben: will open PR feat/hover-sampling-v2 with payload: {estimate, sample_count, ci_low, ci_high, source, method, advisory}. will reuse precomputed bootstrap for high-variance routes to avoid live cost.
jia: thanks. i want rollup fallback by default for low-sample routes so customers aren't scared by negatives.
console-bot: deploybot: queued canary deploy telemetry-hover-v2 in 6m.
maria: perfect. please paste mock payload after PR so QA can validate against failing ticket.
ben: will do. starting branch now.
